The '''Plooriod system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planets]] [[Plooriod III]] and [[Plooriod IV]].

==History==
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the Plooriod system was the site of [[Operation Grain Snatch]].<ref name="X-wing">''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Tour of Duty: Imperial Pursuit]]''</ref>
